releases.notes:
# v1.3.0

## 中文

### 这个版本在做什么

- `worker` / `reader` 队友预设现在挂载 `skill-filesystem` + `tool-skill`：子智能体也能使用项目技能（`<project>/.dsh/skills`、`<project>/.agents/skills`）与用户技能（`~/.dsh/skills`、`~/.agents/skills`）；随 DSH 分发的 `dsh-doc` 仍只给 `lead`。
- 重画插件图标：透明背景、36×36；父节点 → 两个形状与颜色都不同的子节点（品牌蓝实心圆角方 + 琥珀色菱形），表达「同一个父智能体可以给不同子智能体指定不同 preset」。
- `Lead` 的 preset 卡片简介改为「相当于标准模式，另外可以给派生的每个子智能体指定不同的预设」；Plugins 页该行简介同步。
- README（中英）重构：新增 **Usage** 章节（把新会话切到 Lead、用 `agent_preset` 派活的示例、团队协作、如何选 preset）与 **License** 章节；安装方式补上 npm，限制说明重写。
- 安装包内部结构：每个 preset 的声明放在自己的 unit 目录（`lead/preset.patch.yml`、`worker/preset.patch.yml`、`reader/preset.patch.yml`），根 `cordis.patch.yml` 移除。
- npm 发布：`dsh-subagent-preset-select` 现在可从 npm 安装；发布使用 Trusted Publishing（OIDC），不再依赖长期 token。

### 安装包内容

从实际构建的 `.tgz` 生成，深度 1–2：

```text
dsh-subagent-preset-select-1.3.0.tgz
├── package.json # manifest：bundle 补丁列表、files、exports、peer/engines
├── README.md / README.zh.md # 双语说明；同时是插件详情页
├── LICENSE # MIT
├── icon.svg # 插件图标（品牌蓝方形 + 琥珀菱形）
├── locale/{en,zh}.json # bundle 卡片文案 + 按 UI 语言的 meta.detail
├── lead/ # lead 单元：根智能体 preset，暴露 agent_preset
│ ├── index.js # subpath plugin `dsh-subagent-preset-select/lead`
│ ├── preset.patch.yml # 声明：standard 工具列表 + allowedAgentPresets
│ └── locale/{en,zh}.json # 该行在 Plugins 页的标题/简介
├── worker/ # worker 单元：可写队友 preset
│ └── index.js, preset.patch.yml, locale/{en,zh}.json
└── reader/ # reader 单元：只读队友 preset
 └── index.js, preset.patch.yml, locale/{en,zh}.json
```

共 19 个文件；`npm pack` 生成的 `.tgz` 约 11.7 KB。

### 升级注意

- 直接升级即可，无需额外操作：preset 声明、locale 与安装方式保持兼容。
- 装好后在 **Settings → General → Agent preset** 里选择 **Lead**（新会话生效）；已有会话保持启动时的 preset。

### 安装

四种方式装到同一个精简包：Release `.tgz` / Git 地址 / npm（`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-subagent-preset-select@1.3.0`）/ 本地仓库。

### 要求

- DSH `0.2.2-rc.5` Desktop（`engines.dsh`: `>=0.2.2-rc.5 <0.3.0`）。

### 回滚

- **Settings → Agent preset** 把新会话默认切回 `Standard`；或在 Plugins 页禁用/卸载。

### 校验和

- 附 `SHA256SUMS.txt`；用 `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt` 或 Windows `Get-FileHash` 核对。

## English

### What this release changes

- The `worker` / `reader` teammate presets now mount `skill-filesystem` + `tool-skill`, so a child agent can use project skills (`<project>/.dsh/skills`, `<project>/.agents/skills`) and user skills (`~/.dsh/skills`, `~/.agents/skills`). The shipped `dsh-doc` directory stays lead-only.
- Redrawn plugin icon: transparent, 36×36; a parent node branching to two children with different shapes and colors (brand-blue rounded square + amber diamond), showing that one root agent can give each subagent a different preset.
- The `Lead` preset card description is now "The standard mode, plus a per-subagent preset choice"; the matching Plugins row description was updated too.
- README (both languages) restructured: new **Usage** section (switch new sessions to Lead, delegate with `agent_preset`, team hand-off, choosing a preset) and **License** section; npm install added, limits rewritten.
- Package layout: each preset declaration now lives in its own unit folder (`lead/preset.patch.yml`, `worker/preset.patch.yml`, `reader/preset.patch.yml`); the root `cordis.patch.yml` is gone.
- npm publishing: `dsh-subagent-preset-select` is installable from npm; publication uses Trusted Publishing (OIDC) instead of a long-lived token.

### Bundled files

Generated from the built `.tgz`, depth 1–2:

```text
dsh-subagent-preset-select-1.3.0.tgz
├── package.json # manifest: bundle patch list, files, exports, peer/engines
├── README.md / README.zh.md # bilingual user docs; also the plugin detail page
├── LICENSE # MIT
├── icon.svg # bundle icon (brand-blue square + amber diamond)
├── locale/{en,zh}.json # bundle card text + meta.detail per UI language
├── lead/ # the lead unit: root-agent preset exposing agent_preset
│ ├── index.js # subpath plugin `dsh-subagent-preset-select/lead`
│ ├── preset.patch.yml # declaration: standard tool list + allowedAgentPresets
│ └── locale/{en,zh}.json # row title/description on the Plugins page
├── worker/ # the worker unit: writable teammate preset
│ └── index.js, preset.patch.yml, locale/{en,zh}.json
└── reader/ # the reader unit: read-only teammate preset
 └── index.js, preset.patch.yml, locale/{en,zh}.json
```

19 files; the `npm pack` `.tgz` is about 11.7 KB.

### Upgrade notes

- Upgrade in place, no extra steps: preset declarations, locales, and install paths stay compatible.
- Then pick **Lead** in **Settings → General → Agent preset** for new sessions; existing sessions keep the preset they started with.

### Install

All four paths install the same lean package: release `.tgz` / Git address / npm (`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-subagent-preset-select@1.3.0`) / local checkout.

### Requirements

- DSH `0.2.2-rc.5` Desktop (`engines.dsh`: `>=0.2.2-rc.5 <0.3.0`).

### Rollback

- Switch the new-session default back to `Standard` in **Settings → Agent preset**, or disable/uninstall the bundle in Plugins.

### Verification

- `SHA256SUMS.txt` is attached; verify with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt` (or `Get-FileHash`).

## Assets

| Asset | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh-subagent-preset-select-1.3.0.tgz` | installable runtime package |
| `dsh-subagent-preset-select-1.3.0.zip` | the same files, for browsing |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | checksums for both archives |

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/sogeisetsu/subagent-preset-select/compare/v1.2.2...v1.3.0>

# v1.2.2

## 中文

### 这个版本在做什么

- **文档更正**：Git 地址安装与 Release `.tgz` 安装得到的是**同一个精简包**——两者都按 `package.json` 的 `files` 打包（17 个运行时文件）。Git 安装只是额外在本机克隆一次仓库，安装后的目录与 `.tgz` 完全一致。
- 此前 v1.2.0 / v1.2.1 的 README 与 Release 说明里写的“Git 安装会拉取整个仓库”是错误说法，已更正；Git 安装示例也钉到了 `v1.2.2`。
- 无运行时行为变化：补丁、三个 preset（`lead` / `worker` / `reader`）与 locale 均未改动。

### 实测证据

在本机用 pnpm 从 GitHub 的 `v1.2.1` tag 安装：

```
$ pnpm add "github:sogeisetsu/subagent-preset-select#v1.2.1" --ignore-scripts
+ dsh-subagent-preset-select 1.2.1
Done in 20.2s
```

安装目录 `node_modules/dsh-subagent-preset-select` 里恰好是 17 个文件、约 29 KB（未压缩），与 Release `.tgz` 的文件清单一模一样。

### 安装（三种方式，装到的都是精简包）

1. Release 压缩包：下载 `dsh-subagent-preset-select-1.2.2.tgz`，执行 `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <下载目录>/dsh-subagent-preset-select-1.2.2.tgz`，或在 Plugins → Add plugin 里填它的绝对路径。
2. Git 地址：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:sogeisetsu/subagent-preset-select#v1.2.2`（完整写法 `git+https://github.com/sogeisetsu/subagent-preset-select.git#v1.2.2` 也可以）。
3. 本地仓库：克隆后在 Plugins → Add plugin 里填仓库根的绝对路径。

装好后在 Settings → Agent Preset 里选 `Lead`。

### 要求

- DSH `0.2.2-rc.5` Desktop（`engines.dsh`: `>=0.2.2-rc.5 <0.3.0`）。
- Node.js ≥ 22.15 只用于本地校验脚本；安装与运行不需要 Node。

### 回滚

- Settings → Agent Preset 把新会话默认切回 `Standard`；或在 Plugins 页禁用/卸载本插件。
- 官方 `standard` 预设没有被覆盖。

### 校验和

- 附 `SHA256SUMS.txt`，可用 `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt` 或 Windows 的 `Get-FileHash` 核对。

## English

### What this release is

- **Documentation fix:** installing from a Git address and installing the release `.tgz` produce the **same lean package** — both are packed with `package.json` `files` (17 runtime files). A Git install only clones the repository on the installing machine; the installed tree is identical.
- The earlier claim in v1.2.0 / v1.2.1 docs (“a Git install fetches the whole repository”) was wrong and is corrected; the Git-install examples now pin `v1.2.2`.
- No runtime behavior change: the patch, the three presets (`lead`, `worker`, `reader`), and the locales are untouched.

### Measured evidence

Installing the `v1.2.1` tag from GitHub with pnpm on this machine:

```
$ pnpm add "github:sogeisetsu/subagent-preset-select#v1.2.1" --ignore-scripts
+ dsh-subagent-preset-select 1.2.1
Done in 20.2s
```

`node_modules/dsh-subagent-preset-select` contained exactly 17 files, about 29 KB unpacked — the same file list as the release `.tgz`.

### Install (three paths, all lean)

1. Release tarball: download `dsh-subagent-preset-select-1.2.2.tgz`, run `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <downloads>/dsh-subagent-preset-select-1.2.2.tgz`, or give its absolute path in Plugins → Add plugin.
2. Git address: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:sogeisetsu/subagent-preset-select#v1.2.2` (the full `git+https://github.com/sogeisetsu/subagent-preset-select.git#v1.2.2` form works too).
3. Local checkout: clone the repository, then give the repository root's absolute path in Plugins → Add plugin.

Then pick `Lead` in Settings → Agent Preset.

### Requirements

- DSH `0.2.2-rc.5` Desktop (`engines.dsh`: `>=0.2.2-rc.5 <0.3.0`).
- Node.js >= 22.15 is needed only for the local validation script; installing and running the plugin does not need Node.

### Rollback

- Switch the new-session default back to `Standard` in Settings → Agent Preset, or disable/uninstall the bundle in Plugins.
- The shipped `standard` preset is never overwritten.

### Verification

- `SHA256SUMS.txt` is attached; verify with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt` (or `Get-FileHash` on Windows).

## Assets

| Asset | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh-subagent-preset-select-1.2.2.tgz` | installable, lean runtime package (17 files) |
| `dsh-subagent-preset-select-1.2.2.zip` | the same files, for browsing |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | checksums for both archives |

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/sogeisetsu/subagent-preset-select/compare/v1.2.1...v1.2.2>

releases.notes:
# v1.2.0

## 中文

### 这个版本在做什么

- **核心能力**：新增的 `Lead` 智能体预设，让主智能体在调用 `subagent` 时通过 `agent_preset` 为它派生的每个子智能体指定不同的预设（`worker` / `reader` / `cordis`）；不传该参数时，子智能体继承父智能体的预设。
- 同时新增两个队友预设：**Worker**（可写：文件、搜索、shell、子智能体控制工具）与 **Reader**（只读：只有读取与搜索工具，没有任何写入或 shell 工具）。
- 插件名在中英文界面统一为英文 `Subagent preset select`；插件简介重写，突出“Lead 让每个子智能体使用不同预设”这一核心，而不是“新增了三个预设”。
- preset 卡片简介改为中英双语单行（DSH 不对自定义 preset 的显示文案做本地化，见上游 Discussion #3610）。
- 新增 `CONTRIBUTING.md` 与中文 `CHANGELOG.md`。

### 安装

1. 下载本 Release 的 `dsh-subagent-preset-select-1.2.0.tgz`。
2. 任选其一：
 - 命令行：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <下载目录>/dsh-subagent-preset-select-1.2.0.tgz`
 - 桌面端：Plugins → Add plugin，填写该 `.tgz` 的绝对路径。
3. 在 Settings → Agent Preset 里把 `Lead` 设为新会话默认（或对单个会话选择 Lead）。

> `.zip` 只是同样的文件、方便浏览；给 DSH 安装请用 `.tgz`。

### 要求

- DSH `0.2.2-rc.5` Desktop（`package.json` 的 `engines.dsh` 为 `>=0.2.2-rc.5 <0.3.0`）。
- 仅本地校验脚本需要 Node.js ≥ 22.15。

### 回滚

- 在 Settings → Agent Preset 把新会话默认切回 `Standard`；或在 Plugins 页禁用/卸载本插件。
- 官方 `standard` 预设没有被覆盖，不需要恢复任何官方定义。

### 校验和

- 附 `SHA256SUMS.txt`，可用 `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt` 或 Windows 的 `Get-FileHash` 核对。

## English

### What this release is

- **Core capability:** the new `Lead` Agent preset lets the main agent pass `agent_preset` to `subagent` and give every spawned child a different preset (`worker` / `reader` / `cordis`); omitting the parameter inherits the parent's preset.
- Two teammate presets ship alongside it: **Worker** (writable: files, search, shell, subagent controls) and **Reader** (read-only: read and search only, with no write or shell tool).
- The plugin name is English in every UI language (`Subagent preset select`), and the description was rewritten to lead with the capability — Lead lets each subagent run a different preset — instead of “adds three presets”.
- Preset roster descriptions are bilingual single-line strings (DSH does not localize user-authored preset metadata; see upstream Discussion #3610).
- Added `CONTRIBUTING.md` and a Chinese `CHANGELOG.md`.

### Install

1. Download `dsh-subagent-preset-select-1.2.0.tgz` from this release.
2. Either:
 - CLI: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <downloads>/dsh-subagent-preset-select-1.2.0.tgz`
 - Desktop: Plugins → Add plugin, then the absolute path of the `.tgz`.
3. Pick `Lead` as the new-session default in Settings → Agent Preset (or select it for a single session).

> The `.zip` holds the same files for browsing; install DSH from the `.tgz`.

### Requirements

- DSH `0.2.2-rc.5` Desktop (`engines.dsh`: `>=0.2.2-rc.5 <0.3.0`).
- Node.js >= 22.15 only for the local validation script.

### Rollback

- Switch the new-session default back to `Standard` in Settings → Agent Preset, or disable/uninstall the bundle in Plugins.
- The shipped `standard` preset is never overwritten.

### Verification

- `SHA256SUMS.txt` is attached; verify with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt` (or `Get-FileHash` on Windows).

en.headline: 49 own commits plus 17 automated, and four plugin releases
en.summary: **49 own commits** landed on 2026-11-28, plus **17 automated commits** by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/subagent-preset-select`, 47 own commits tightened the README opening and install requirements, documented trusted publishing and its pitfalls, and reworked the npm OIDC flow in CI by pinning npm 11, using `--provenance`, and stopping `setup-node` from shadowing the token exchange. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 2 own commits aligned the summary highlights number prompt with its validation and synchronized summary figures after backfilling so the daily-report publishing gate was released. Four releases were published for `sogeisetsu/subagent-preset-select`: `v1.2.0`, `v1.2.1`, `v1.2.2`, and `v1.3.0`. No pull requests, issues, or reviews were recorded.

releaseNotes.summary: The `worker` and `reader` teammate presets now mount `skill-filesystem` and `tool-skill`, letting child agents use project and user skills while `dsh-doc` stays lead-only. The plugin icon was redrawn as a transparent 36×36 parent-to-two-children graphic, and the `Lead` card description was updated in both locales. The bilingual README gained Usage and License sections, npm installation was added, and each preset declaration moved into its own unit directory with the root `cordis.patch.yml` removed. Publishing now uses npm Trusted Publishing via OIDC instead of a long-lived token.

This release corrects the documentation claim that a Git-address install pulls the whole repository: Git and release `.tgz` installs produce the same lean package of 17 runtime files. The earlier wording in `v1.2.0` and `v1.2.1` was wrong and the Git-install examples now pin `v1.2.2`. No runtime behavior changed; the patch, the `lead` / `worker` / `reader` presets, and the locales are untouched.

The `package.json` `files` list was narrowed to runtime files only, so `AGENTS.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `docs/`, `scripts/`, and `.github/` are no longer installed with the plugin. Installing directly from a GitHub address, optionally pinned to a tag, was added alongside the release tarball and local checkout paths. The `.tgz` asset shrank from about 25 KB to about 10 KB with 17 files, and the `.zip` shrank accordingly.

The new `Lead` agent preset lets the main agent pass `agent_preset` to `subagent` so each spawned child can use a different preset such as `worker`, `reader`, or `cordis`, while omitting the parameter inherits the parent's preset. Two teammate presets were added: `Worker` with file, search, shell, and subagent-control tools, and `Reader` limited to read and search tools. The plugin name was unified as `Subagent preset select`, the description was rewritten around per-subagent preset selection, and `CONTRIBUTING.md` plus a Chinese `CHANGELOG.md` were added.

releaseNotes.summary: `worker` 与 `reader` 队友预设现在挂载 `skill-filesystem` 和 `tool-skill`，使子智能体可使用项目技能与用户技能，而 `dsh-doc` 仍仅提供给 lead。插件图标重绘为 36×36 透明背景的父节点连接两个不同形状子节点图形，`Lead` 卡片简介也在两种语言中同步更新。中英双语 README 新增 Usage 与 License 章节并补充 npm 安装方式，每个 preset 的声明移入各自的 unit 目录，根 `cordis.patch.yml` 被移除。发布改用 npm Trusted Publishing 的 OIDC 流程，不再依赖长期 token。
